phoneticConvention: Syllable-by-syllable romaji for English readers, in the deck's style (so-o-de-su, ko-wa-i-de-su). Read each syllable as in Spanish or Italian: a as in 'father', i as in 'machine', u as in 'put', e as in 'bet', o as in 'go'. A long vowel is written twice (ko-o-hi-i, to-o-kyo-o); ん is its own beat written n (su-mi-ma-se-n, ko-n-ni-chi-wa); a doubled consonant closes the syllable before it (kip-pu, chot-to, kek-ko-o). The u of de-su / ma-su is almost silent ('dess', 'mass'); r is a light tap between r and l; g is always hard. The reading field gives the hiragana. Polite register (です / ます) throughout.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended; linguistic review required (naturalness of phrasing, kanji readings).

turns.study: いいえ、十時じゃなくて、午後二時です。
turns.reading: いいえ、じゅうじじゃなくて、ごごにじです。
turns.phon: i-i-e, ju-u-ji ja na-ku-te, go-go ni-ji de-su
turns.native: No, not ten: two in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: すみません、あまり分かりませんでした。つまり、午前中は来なくてもいいということですか。
turns.reading: すみません、あまりわかりませんでした。つまり、ごぜんちゅうはこなくてもいいということですか。
turns.phon: su-mi-ma-se-n, a-ma-ri wa-ka-ri-ma-se-n de-shi-ta. tsu-ma-ri, go-ze-n-chu-u wa ko-na-ku-te mo i-i to i-u ko-to de-su ka
turns.native: Sorry, I didn't quite understand. In other words, I don't need to come in the morning?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: いいえ。私が言いたいのは、会議だけが午後に変わったということです。
turns.reading: いいえ。わたしがいいたいのは、かいぎだけがごごにかわったということです。
turns.phon: i-i-e. wa-ta-shi ga i-i-ta-i no wa, ka-i-gi da-ke ga go-go ni ka-wat-ta to i-u ko-to de-su
turns.native: No. What I mean is that only the meeting has moved to the afternoon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 分かりました。資料は間に合うかどうか、よく分かりません。
turns.reading: わかりました。しりょうはまにあうかどうか、よくわかりません。
turns.phon: wa-ka-ri-ma-shi-ta. shi-ryo-o wa ma-ni-a-u ka do-o ka, yo-ku wa-ka-ri-ma-se-n
turns.native: I see. As for the documents, I'm not really sure whether they'll be ready in time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 一部でもいいですよ。全部じゃなくても大丈夫です。
turns.reading: いちぶでもいいですよ。ぜんぶじゃなくてもだいじょうぶです。
turns.phon: i-chi-bu de mo i-i de-su yo. ze-n-bu ja na-ku-te mo da-i-jo-o-bu de-su
turns.native: Part of them is fine. They don't all have to be ready.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ありがとうございます。じゃあ、午後二時に。
turns.reading: ありがとうございます。じゃあ、ごごにじに。
turns.phon: a-ri-ga-to-o go-za-i-ma-su. ja-a, go-go ni-ji ni
turns.native: Thank you. See you at two, then.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: はい、お願いします。
turns.reading: はい、おねがいします。
turns.phon: ha-i, o-ne-ga-i shi-ma-su
turns.native: Yes, see you then.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Rephrase (つまり…ということです, 私が言いたいのは…), qualify (どちらかと言うと, あまり…ません, 一部は), express uncertainty (かもしれません, かどうか分かりません), report a problem and ask what to do, check understanding (…ということですか) and describe a symptom.
